timeReview.title: Supplier timing agreement
timeReview.help: This version uses a non-default billing timestamp. Verify the supplier agreement for every selected target. This attestation does not verify supplier timestamps or invoices; missing time evidence stays unknown.
timeReview.default: Dispatch time is the default. No additional timing attestation is required.
timeReview.unused: No current rule uses the calendar, but this version still explicitly selects a non-default time basis.
timeReview.referenceHelp: Use an opaque review-record ID: 1–128 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. Do not enter contract text, prices, secrets or URLs.
timeReview.confirm: I verified that the supplier agreement uses this time basis for every selected target.
timeReview.editorHelp: Drafts may explore any time basis. Publishing or rolling back to supplier-accepted/completed time requires a fresh, version-bound agreement confirmation.
timeReview.required: Review and confirm the supplier timing agreement before publication.
timeReview.invalid: The timing review could not be verified. Refresh and preview again.
publicationFx.title: Report-currency coverage
publicationFx.help: Checks the proposed activation interval against the current FX catalog. This does not freeze future FX changes.
publicationFx.globalHelp: Global prices are checked against global FX only; a private workspace conversion cannot supply global coverage.
publicationFx.not_required: No conversion is needed for USD prices.
publicationFx.covered: Available FX covers the proposed interval.
publicationFx.incomplete: FX coverage is incomplete. Original-currency costs remain available; USD amounts are unknown in the listed gaps, never zero.
publicationFx.acknowledge: I understand the missing USD conversion and want to publish the original-currency prices.
publicationFx.invalid: The FX review could not be verified. Refresh and preview again.
error.activationConflict: This interval overlaps a scheduled activation. Change the interval or explicitly cancel the conflicting schedule before publishing. Refreshing alone does not resolve it.
cost.cacheReferenceHelp: Reference savings are hypothetical: the logical-usage estimate recorded for this cache-hit request minus its zero supplier cost. They are not budget credits, confirmed savings or a forecast using current prices.
cost.cacheReferenceUnavailable: The original reference is missing, unpriced or cannot be verified. Savings remain unknown, not zero.
budgetBasis.realtimeCustody: Realtime settles connection time and model responses together. Parallel commands require unique correlation or supplier-confirmed manual generation. Unacknowledged work and unclassified automatic audio keep the reservation pending; this is not complete VAD or transcription accounting.
admission.realtimeHelp: Strict Realtime admission requires this response limit and a session_seconds limit covering the gateway session timeout. Token limits are per response.
metering.notice.realtime_session_contrac: Realtime prices are frozen for the session. Each response is charged once; request_count means model responses, not connections. Explicit session time fees are separate. Unknown or conflicting events retain the allowance for review.
title: Pricing
description: Versioned rates, clear units, explainable costs.
newHelp: Start with unpriced dimensions. Creating a draft does not activate rates.
name: Name
empty: No price books yet. Create a draft or import an exported book.
selectHelp: Configure rates and rules without changing in-flight requests or historical costs.
viewer: Read-only access. You can inspect rates and run simulations.
schema.title: Pricing initialization required
schema.help: This page never migrates a database automatically. An operator must review and run the explicit pricing migration in an approved maintenance window.
removeConfirm: Remove this configuration from the draft?
importTooLarge: Import files must be at most 1 MiB.
importValidated: Import validated; saving creates a draft only.
readOnly: Published versions are immutable. Create a draft to edit; viewers cannot change prices.
draftSafety: Draft edits do not affect traffic. Publishing changes prices for new requests only.
saved: Draft saved. Live prices are unchanged.
validated: Schema validated. Review coverage warnings before publication.
publishedNotice: A new price version was published.
discardConfirm: Discard unsaved pricing changes and continue?
conflictHelp: Another update won the revision check. Your edits are retained; compare the server draft before reloading.
meteringWarning: A configured unit is not proof of metering support. Verify provider usage fields and missing-usage behavior before publishing.
legacy.help: Only edited base prices are patched. Hidden cache, media and capability fields are preserved. Remove an override explicitly to inherit.
legacy.removeConfirm: Remove ALL legacy price overrides for {{model}}, including hidden cache/media prices? Other capabilities are retained.
legacy.invalid: Enter a unique model and both nonnegative base prices. Blank fields are not zero.
rule.orderHelp: Rules within a group are alternatives. Groups apply in order; higher rule priority wins.
rule.segmentedUnavailable: Progressive overflow tiers are not supported by this schema and cannot be enabled.
rule.exclusiveMax: Blank means no upper bound. Cached input is included in the total.
rule.tierHelp: Comma-separated identifiers, such as default, priority, flex or batch. No automatic multiplier is assumed.
rule.tagsHelp: Use tags declared in this book's calendar. Blank adds no time condition.
rule.commaValues: Comma-separated allowed values; blank means no condition.
rates.title: Rate components
rates.help: Add only the rates this rule changes. Empty rules inherit prior groups; an absent base rate remains unpriced.
rates.dimensionHelp: Missing quantities stay unknown. Declaring a dimension does not invent usage for it.
rates.removeRatesFirst: Remove this dimension's rates and multipliers from every rule before unchecking it.
rates.combined: Contract explicitly permits additive / overlapping media charges
calendar.help: Windows use the configured timezone, not the browser's. Cross-midnight windows and date overrides are explicit.
calendar.removeConfirm: Remove the calendar? Rules with time tags will require correction before saving.
simulation.title: Cost simulator
simulation.help: Use synthetic quantities. Blank is unknown, explicit zero is zero. Results do not change budgets or historical receipts.
simulation.notInvoice: A local calculation is not a reconciled supplier invoice.
simulation.stale: Inputs changed. Run again to update these results.
publish.title: Publish price version
publish.safety: Review every target and activation time. A new catalog revision affects new requests only; history and in-flight work retain their original prices.
publish.operationHelp: Canonical ingress name, for example image_generation. Blank matches all operations.
publish.dateHelp: Use an explicit UTC offset or Z. Future schedules can be cancelled; active prices change through a new publication.
publish.impact: {{added}} bindings in this publication; {{replaced}} existing bindings replaced.
publish.confirm: I reviewed the scope, timing and warnings. Apply this version to new requests.
publish.cancelReason: Reason for cancelling this future activation
versions.title: Published versions
error.workspace: Workspace changed. Reopen the price book in the intended workspace.
error.conflict: A newer revision exists. Reload and compare before saving.
error.denied: You do not have permission for this pricing action.
error.notFound: This pricing resource is unavailable in the current workspace.
error.validation: Configuration is not valid. Review the fields and diagnostics.
error.request: The request failed. Your unsaved edits are retained.
diagnostic.pricing_dimension_missing: Required price or quantity is missing
navigation.title: Leave pricing?
navigation.busy: An operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish before leaving or switching workspaces.
governance.title: Admission & exchange rates
governance.help: Manage workspace overrides or global defaults. These are catalog changes, not gateway configuration reloads.
governance.stale: The catalog changed. Your edits are retained. Close this dialog, refresh, and compare before trying again.
governance.confirm: I reviewed the scope and changes. Apply them to new requests only; preserve in-flight and historical snapshots.
governance.safety: Validation is read-only. Applying creates an audited catalog revision; it does not reprice past requests or call providers.
admission.title: Request admission policy
admission.inheritance: Resolution order: workspace operation → workspace default → global operation → global default → compatibility.
admission.help.inherit: Remove this override. The next applicable policy supplies the behavior; this does not always mean compatibility mode.
admission.help.compatibility: Keep marked estimates and legacy fallback. This is not a guaranteed spending cap.
admission.help.reject_unpriced: Require an approved usable price binding before dispatch. Reservations remain estimates, not upper bounds.
admission.help.reserve_upper_bound: Reject requests without a provable bound under the declared supplier limits. Incorrect or unsupported limits invalidate the guarantee.
admission.limitHelp: Blank means unbounded, not zero. Requested image count or duration is not automatically an actual-output cap. No supplier limits are invented here.
fx.title: Versioned exchange rates
fx.help: Requests pin their FX snapshot. Cross-currency totals stay unknown when a required rate is missing; currencies are never silently relabeled.
fx.empty: No FX overrides. Same-currency calculation needs no conversion.
fx.replacement: This replaces the entire FX schedule in the selected scope. Keep every interval you still need. Other scopes and frozen request snapshots remain unchanged.
batch.shareHelp: Allocated share of a shared invocation. Member usage is estimated; physical cost and its rounding are preserved below. Do not add the physical total to this share.
cost.title: Request cost evidence
cost.help: Recorded usage, immutable prices and settlement history. No provider content is shown.
cost.totalHelp: Totals include recorded attempts. Unknown and pending amounts are not zero; nested physical batch totals are not added again.
cost.legacy: Legacy estimate: the stored amount is preserved. There is insufficient immutable evidence for replay; current rates are not substituted.
cost.budgetHelp: Budget accounting follows the recorded policy and may differ from upstream cost. Reservations are not final charges.
cost.cacheHelp: A local cache hit makes no new provider call. Logical usage and its compatible budget charge are separate from upstream cost and the stored reference estimate.
cost.pendingHelp: No terminal receipt yet. The final cost is unknown, not zero.
cost.boundHelp: Bounds are conditional on declared limits, not a promise that the provider cannot exceed them. Observed excesses remain recorded.
replay.title: Simulate historical usage
replay.help: Select a draft or published version. Only recorded metering metadata is replayed, using effective corrections. No model is called and no budget or history is changed. Missing FX stays unknown.
replay.unavailable: No replayable metering receipt for this attempt.
replay.unchanged: Simulation only. Historical receipts, budgets and active prices remain unchanged.
correction.title: Batch usage correction
correction.help: Administrator attestation, not supplier invoice confirmation. Correct the physical batch, not an individual share. Original price and FX snapshots are retained; every member is updated atomically with an append-only audit.
correction.missingHelp: Blank or missing means unknown; enter 0 only when explicitly attesting zero. Keep total and subset quantities consistent. This form never labels your entries as provider-reported.
correction.impactHelp: Amounts below are member costs, not budget deltas. Budget effects follow each member’s recorded policy, winner and budget period. No changes have been applied by this preview.
correction.confirm: I reviewed every member and authorize this append-only usage correction. This is not invoice confirmation.
correction.conflict: The recorded batch changed. Your edits are retained, but cannot overwrite it. Read the current state, then close and refresh before starting a new proposal.
correction.uncertain: The write outcome is unknown. Do not create a different correction. Retry the same ID or check the recorded state; fields stay locked.
correction.notRecorded: This correction is not in the latest read. An earlier write may still finish. Prefer retrying the same ID; refresh before any new proposal.
correction.leaveUncertain: The previous write may still complete. Leave this proposal and refresh recorded costs? Do not submit a new correction without reviewing them.
replay.cacheReference: Simulated cache reference — not an upstream charge
recovery.title: Budget recovery
recovery.description: Review interrupted accounting without repeating model requests.
recovery.budgetOnly: Internal budget only — not a supplier invoice
recovery.supplierWarning: Releasing a hold does not make a request free. Provider cost can remain unknown after the budget is handled.
recovery.inventoryScope: This inventory covers recorded recovery cases, not every gateway request. Amounts describe each request and must not be summed across repeated cases.
recovery.emptyBatch: No matches in this inspected batch. More records remain; continue scanning.
recovery.groupHelp: Every unresolved member needs a decision. Existing costs and terminal siblings are not overwritten.
recovery.invalidResponse: The reply could not confirm this proposal. Verify the recorded result or retry the same ID.
recovery.storageError: This tab cannot save or clear its pending-submission record. Verify server records before proceeding; no automatic retry is made.
recovery.pendingRestored: Pending proposal restored in this tab
recovery.uncertain: The server may already have applied this proposal. Fields stay locked. Check its recorded result or retry the exact saved proposal, never a new ID.
recovery.notRecorded: No confirmed result is visible yet. This does not prove an earlier request will not finish. Retrying the same proposal is preferred.
recovery.conflict: The current evidence or permissions changed. Your draft is retained. Reread the group and preview again; this message does not undo any prior write.
recovery.reread: Reread and keep valid draft choices
recovery.successReplayed: Recorded decision confirmed — no repeat debit
recovery.successHelp: This confirmation covers internal budget handling only. Provider cost and invoice evidence are separate.
recovery.unknownAfter: Provider outcomes still unknown: {{count}}. They are not zero-cost requests.
recovery.inspectOnly: Operators can inspect the complete group. Only a workspace administrator may submit budget decisions.
recovery.noHolds: No unresolved budget holds remain in this group. Cost evidence may still need review.
recovery.allMembers: Choose a decision for every pending member, including members on other pages. Existing terminal siblings are read-only.
recovery.storageNotice: After you submit, only this proposal and its preview are temporarily saved in this tab for exact retries. They are removed after confirmation. Do not include prompts or secrets in the reason.
recovery.noRefundGuarantee: Reserved amounts are not promised refunds against the current period. Epoch changes and recorded policy determine the actual budget effect. This preview changes nothing.
recovery.confirm: I reviewed every member and authorize these internal-budget decisions. Releasing a hold does not waive supplier charges or confirm invoices.
recovery.confirmRetry: I authorize retrying the exact saved proposal. It may already be applied; the same ID prevents a repeat debit.
recovery.tokensHint: The receipt lacks complete token totals. Enter an explicit nonnegative integer for internal accounting; blank is not zero.
recovery.liveBlocked: The lease is active. Do not override a request that may still be running.
recovery.asyncBlocked: This reservation is owned by an asynchronous job and cannot be overridden here.
recovery.terminalSibling: Already handled member — retained for whole-group context, not changed by this proposal.
recovery.releaseHint: Only the internal hold is released. Known and unknown provider costs are preserved.
recovery.cacheNote: A local cache hit has zero new upstream cost; its original logical-budget price can still be nonzero. Review the separate budget preview.
recovery.recordedHint: An immutable intent already exists. Its amounts and outcome cannot be replaced here.
recovery.abandonUncertain: The old request may still finish; rereading does not cancel it. Reread current evidence, retain valid choices and require a new preview before any new proposal?
recovery.clearStorageConfirm: Reread server evidence and clear only the local tab record? This does not undo any submitted operation.
usageRecovery.title: Recover missing usage
usageRecovery.description: Record the first receipt using the original prices. Never repeat model work.
usageRecovery.warning: Administrator attestation — not a confirmed supplier receipt
usageRecovery.boundary: This records estimated provider cost only. Budgets, invoice approval and request success are not changed or confirmed.
usageRecovery.eligibility: Only missing first provider receipts are eligible. Active leases, async jobs, pending intents and batches without allocation evidence are blocked by the server. Existing receipts require linked corrections.
usageRecovery.none: No missing first provider receipt is available in this group.
usageRecovery.blocked: This selection is no longer eligible or is still owned. Keep the draft, reread the group, and review the recorded evidence.
usageRecovery.quantityHelp: Blank means missing, not zero. Enter 0 explicitly only when supported by your review. Token/count fields require integers; seconds allow decimals.
usageRecovery.partitions: Input total includes cache. Uncached input, cache read, unclassified write, 5-minute write and 1-hour write must be disjoint. Nothing is inferred from omitted fields.
usageRecovery.conditionsHelp: Leave blank to preserve recorded context. Times require an explicit UTC offset; no browser timezone is assumed. New condition evidence is estimated and cannot change the original target, operation or dispatch time.
usageRecovery.digestHelp: Enter only the 64-character lowercase digest, never a document, path, URL, prompt or credential. A digest is not supplier confirmation.
usageRecovery.partial: Some costs are still unknown. Saving does not make missing prices or quantities zero; later evidence requires a linked correction.
usageRecovery.confirm: I attest to these quantities and reviewed every affected member. Record estimated costs only; do not change budgets or claim supplier confirmation.
usageRecovery.confirmRetry: Retry the original ID and body. It may already be recorded; do not create another receipt.
usageRecovery.successHelp: Costs remain administrator estimates. Review the budget separately; this did not approve a supplier invoice or confirm request success.
usageRecovery.conflict: The evidence changed or this operation is not eligible. Your draft is retained. Reread before previewing; never overwrite an existing receipt.
usageRecovery.invalidReply: The response could not be verified. Do not assume the write failed; check its ID or retry the same proposal.
usageRecovery.storage: Before submission, this tab saves only the exact proposal and a limited cost preview for retries. It clears them after verified completion. Do not enter prompts or secrets. Closing the tab can lose this retry aid.
usageRecovery.abandon: No record was found, but an earlier write could still finish. Reread and abandon this retry identity only after investigating. Continue?
usageRecovery.switchConfirm: Changing the attempt clears its quantities, conditions and reason. Continue?
usageRecovery.inspectOnly: Operators may review evidence; only workspace administrators may attest to missing usage.
usageRecovery.shareHelp: This is an allocated share. Do not add the full physical cost again. Exact rounding is already included in the displayed share.
attemptCorrection.title: Correct recorded usage
attemptCorrection.help: Append a reviewed revision. Original receipts and historical prices stay intact.
attemptCorrection.warning: Administrator estimate, not supplier confirmation. This correction may change the logical budget; review its impact before applying.
attemptCorrection.epochHelp: These are logical charges, not account balances. Refunds belong to the original budget periods; a current-period credit is not guaranteed.
attemptCorrection.replaceHelp: Quantities are initialized from current effective usage. This is a complete replacement, not a patch: omitted or blank dimensions become missing, never implicit zero. Optional conditions remain unchanged when blank.
attemptCorrection.noEffect: No budget delta is applied by this correction. An unresolved hold still needs a separate decision; a released hold is not charged again.
attemptCorrection.pending: Budget correction remains pending because usage or the logical winner is uncertain. Missing cost is not a refund of zero.
attemptCorrection.allocationsHelp: Each row is a delta for one budget rule and its original period. Overlapping scopes must not be summed as separate supplier charges.
attemptCorrection.confirm: I reviewed the replacement usage, cost change and every original-period budget delta. Apply this audited correction, without changing the original receipt.
attemptCorrection.confirmRetry: Retry the exact original correction. It may already have changed budgets; the same ID prevents duplicate deltas.
attemptCorrection.replayed: Original correction confirmed — no duplicate delta
attemptCorrection.successHelp: Original receipts remain unchanged. Review effective history for this revision; these costs remain administrator estimates, not approved supplier invoices.
attemptCorrection.conflict: Evidence or ownership changed. The draft is retained, but the preview is not applicable. Reread the basis and review the replacement quantities before previewing again.
attemptCorrection.storage: Before applying, this tab saves the exact proposal and a limited cost/budget preview for safe retries, then clears them after verified completion. Do not enter prompts or secrets. Closing the tab can lose this aid.
attemptCorrection.block.batch_group_requ: This is a shared batch. Correct the complete physical group from request-cost details.
attemptCorrection.block.not_provider: Local-cache and synthetic receipts cannot be corrected as provider charges.
attemptCorrection.block.lease_active: The request may still be active. Do not override its owner; reread after completion.
attemptCorrection.block.async_owned: An asynchronous job owns this receipt. Use its task lifecycle, not a manual override.
attemptCorrection.block.pending_intent: Apply the existing immutable settlement decision before correcting this receipt.
attemptCorrection.inspectOnly: Read-only access. Only workspace administrators can correct recorded usage.
disposition.title: Retained evidence
disposition.description: Review retained alternatives without rewriting original receipts.
disposition.reviewHelp: Choose existing evidence, not new prices or quantities.
disposition.warning: Internal runtime evidence, not supplier authentication or invoice confirmation. Alternatives must not be counted as extra charges.
disposition.budgetBoundary: Accepting receipts can adjust an existing logical charge, but never chooses a budget winner or applies the stored settlement proposal.
disposition.stateHelp.review_required: The original review state is retained even after a separate decision.
disposition.stateHelp.pending: Durably retained; original receipt or intent delivery is still pending.
disposition.stateHelp.delivered: Writer acknowledgement only; not proof of a settled budget or supplier invoice.
disposition.inventoryHelp: This inventory covers retained outcomes, not all traffic. Each version is an alternative; no totals are summed here.
disposition.empty: No retained outcomes in this state.
disposition.conflict: Evidence or ownership changed. Your action and reason are preserved; reread the basis and preview again before applying.
disposition.successHelp: Original receipts and retained documents remain intact. This decision does not confirm a supplier invoice or replace the original budget decision.
disposition.inspectOnly: Read-only access. Only workspace administrators can decide how to use retained evidence.
disposition.block.already_disposed: This outcome already has an immutable decision. Read its recorded acknowledgement; do not submit a new decision.
disposition.block.not_review_required: Only outcomes requiring review can receive a decision here.
disposition.acceptHelp: Accepting covers every independent receipt in this outcome, including hidden pages. New first receipts do not settle a hold; linked corrections may adjust its existing logical charge.
disposition.rejectHelp: Not selecting this evidence keeps it available for audit. It does not mean zero supplier cost, refund a charge, release a hold or change existing receipts.
disposition.storage: Before applying, this tab saves only the exact proposal and compact verified review for retries. Consent resets after reload; closing the tab can lose this aid. Do not enter prompts or secrets.
disposition.noReceipt: No original receipt. Missing is not zero.
disposition.noReceipts: This entry carries a budget proposal only. It can be rejected, but cannot create usage receipts.
disposition.operation.initial_receipt: Record the first receipt; budget decision stays separate
disposition.confirmAccept: I reviewed every selected receipt and original-period budget delta. Apply this audited decision without adopting the stored budget proposal or confirming an invoice.
disposition.confirmReject: I choose not to select this evidence and to retain it for audit. I understand this causes no refund, hold release, receipt change or zero-cost claim.
disposition.confirmRetry: Retry the exact original decision ID and body. Do not create a second decision.
disposition.membersHelp: Inspect current and retained usage. Selection includes every receipt, not just this page. Quantities are read-only.
groupDisposition.title: Group evidence review
groupDisposition.description: Review complete physical calls and their allocated receipts.
groupDisposition.reviewHelp: Inspect every represented receipt before selecting retained evidence.
groupDisposition.warning: One physical call, conserved allocations — not separate supplier invoices.
groupDisposition.budgetBoundary: A decision never selects a new budget winner or applies the stored budget proposal. Supplier confirmation remains unverified.
groupDisposition.successHelp: The complete acknowledgement matches the reviewed evidence. Original custody and logical budget decisions remain unchanged.
groupDisposition.conflict: Evidence, ownership or a budget period changed. Your choice and reason are retained; reread the group and preview again.
groupDisposition.rejectStillAvailable: When no active owner blocks review, you may still record nonselection without changing money.
groupDisposition.acceptHelp: Accept all supported retained receipts together, under their original price and FX. Complete physical groups stay atomic.
groupDisposition.rejectHelp: Keep the complete evidence but do not select it. This is not a refund, release, zero-cost decision or supplier confirmation.
groupDisposition.storage: Only scoped retry identifiers and compact reviewed totals are saved in this tab. No raw provider payload is stored.
groupDisposition.confirmAccept: I reviewed every represented receipt and the exact budget-period effects. Accept the complete supported evidence, not the stored budget proposal.
groupDisposition.confirmReject: Record nonselection of this complete group while keeping evidence and money unchanged.
groupDisposition.confirmRetry: Retry this exact operation ID and reviewed complete-group decision; do not create another charge.
groupDisposition.physicalHelp: Compare physical totals first. Member allocations below are shares of these totals, not additional calls.
groupDisposition.membersHelp: Pagination is for inspection only. Preview and confirmation always cover every represented receipt, including historical and independent receipts.
groupDisposition.impactHelp: Reviewed receipts: {{count}}. Every page belongs to this single decision. Retained and accepted hashes may differ because linked revisions add metadata.
groupDisposition.allocationHelp: This is an allocated share of the physical fee. Rounding preserves the complete total; it is not a separately priced request.
groupDisposition.inventoryHelp: This list contains retained alternatives, not all traffic. An original custody state and an operator decision are separate facts. Do not add alternatives together as costs.
groupDisposition.empty: No retained groups in this state.
groupDisposition.block.no_receipts: No cost receipts are available to accept.
groupDisposition.block.ambiguous_receipt: Retained receipts disagree; acceptance is blocked.
groupDisposition.block.manifest_missing: The original physical membership cannot be verified.
groupDisposition.block.incomplete_histor: Changed historical evidence is incomplete; missing shares will not be invented.
groupDisposition.block.inconsistent_grou: Original member authority or revision history is inconsistent.
groupDisposition.block.allocation_failur: The physical fee could not be safely allocated.
inheritance.title: Price inheritance
inheritance.selectHelp: Choose an accessible published version. Later parent releases do not change this draft or its published prices.
inheritance.stageHelp: This replaces the current editor content with the complete parent price, including cache and media fields. Nothing is saved or published yet.
inheritance.stageConfirm: I understand that this replaces my current price edits.
inheritance.stage: Use this parent in the editor
inheritance.frozenHelp: The exact parent version is frozen. Publishing a newer parent does not reprice this version or historical requests.
inheritance.snapshotHelp: The hashes above identify the last saved or parent-preview snapshot, not unvalidated edits. The origin labels below describe the current editor recipe.
inheritance.editHelp: Edit rates in the sections below. Unchanged components remain inherited; structural rule changes explicitly replace their whole group.
inheritance.resetConfirm: Restore this item from the fixed parent? Other rate edits are preserved. Rule conditions must still be validated.
inheritance.resetGroupConfirm: Replace this entire group with the fixed parent's group? All local conditions and component edits in this group will be removed.
inheritance.parentUnavailable: The fixed parent could not be verified. Editing and saving are locked; retry or inspect the original version. No replacement price was assumed.
inheritance.invalid: The price content, parent identity or lineage does not match. Refresh and inspect before saving or publishing.
inheritance.readOnlyValidation: Materialized prices validated. Parent editing is administrator-only; this check does not change or reapprove the inheritance.
inheritance.clearImport: Remove the imported or copied price definition and start a fresh manual draft? This does not detach or change the original price book.
inheritance.publicationUncertain: The publication reply could not be verified. It may already have applied. Inspect version history and bindings before trying again.
inheritance.historicalHelp: Read only the immutable version and hash recorded on this cost receipt. This does not use today's prices or recalculate historical costs.
inheritance.noVersion: This record has no complete immutable price reference. Its recorded amount is unchanged; a current price will not be substituted.
inheritance.sourceUnavailable: The original price source is unavailable or its hash could not be verified. The recorded cost is unchanged.
inheritance.noParent: This immutable version has no parent-price inheritance.
mediaOps.title: Media tasks
mediaOps.inventoryHelp: Persisted media tasks only, not all gateway traffic. Job state and financial settlement are separate.
mediaOps.ledgerHelp: These are recorded costs and budget effects. A known job or accepted receipt does not prove final settlement.
mediaOps.lookupHelp: Use a job ID you independently verified belongs to this request. The gateway queries the original account only; it never generates again. You attest the association, not a supplier invoice.
mediaOps.timeHelp: Missing supplier timestamps remain unknown. Local recovery time is not used as the supplier's acceptance or completion time.
mediaOps.confirmLookup: I verified this job belongs to the original request, reviewed the evidence and original price, and authorize recording this association and processing its cost.
mediaOps.retryConfirm: Retry the exact recorded proposal with the same operation ID. Do not create another operation.
mediaOps.uncertain: The reply is unconfirmed. The association may already be recorded. Check its receipt or retry this exact operation; do not submit a new ID.
mediaOps.conflict: The task, permission or provider evidence changed. Your fields remain intact. Reload the basis and review a new preview before applying.
mediaOps.recorded: The original association receipt is verified. This confirms recording, not final financial settlement.
mediaOps.processingPending: Evidence is durable, but financial processing is pending. Inspect the ledger before taking any further action.
mediaOps.checkLedger: Check the refreshed task ledger for pending, unknown and settled amounts. Receipt acknowledgement alone does not finish processing.
mediaOps.sessionHelp: Only the scoped operation ID, exact proposal hashes, job ID and reason are saved in this browser session for retry; no provider body or secret is stored.
mediaOps.abandon: No receipt was found. Abandon this pending proposal and reload the task? Keep the old operation ID in your incident notes in case a delayed reply arrives.
mediaOps.invalid: The returned identity or evidence hash does not match. No success is confirmed; inspect the original operation.
mediaOps.inspectOnly: Operator view only. An administrator is required to change sources or associate a job.
mediaOps.eventHelp: Alternatives are evidence, not additional charges. Arrival time does not establish supplier sequence. Review decisions and hashes before acting.
mediaOps.normalizedOnly: Allowlisted normalized metadata only; this is not the original provider response.
mediaOps.sourceHelp: Sources are workspace-scoped and pinned to an original node and credential. Configuration does not send a webhook or generate media.
mediaOps.secretHelp: Enter only a dedicated SIFTGATE_MEDIA_EVENT_ variable name. A deployment administrator supplies its independent signing key outside this page. Never paste provider keys or secret values here.
mediaOps.noSources: No registered sources. Signed events are not accepted until a source is configured.
mediaOps.sourceConfirm: I reviewed the original node, credential and signing variable and authorize this source configuration change.
mediaOps.sourceUncertain: The configuration reply is unknown. Read the current source before retrying. Any retry uses the same original revision and cannot overwrite a newer configuration.
mediaOps.sourceSaved: The current source matches the requested configuration and its hash is verified. This is a state check, not proof that a particular earlier reply was delivered.
mediaOps.sourceConflict: The source changed or the request was rejected. Your input is retained. Read the current source before starting a new revision.
mediaOps.currentReviewed: Current state was read. It does not match the pending change, or the source does not exist.
mediaOps.sourceRebase: Discard the pending form and start from the inspected current source? The old server configuration is not modified by this action.
mediaOps.block.already_reconciled: A job association is already recorded. Inspect its receipt and ledger.
mediaOps.block.ordered_source_owned: An ordered source owns this task; use its verified event workflow.
mediaOps.block.job_already_known: The provider job is already known.
mediaOps.block.not_unknown_submission: Only an uncertain submission can use this lookup.
mediaOps.block.terminal_evidence_present: Terminal cost evidence already exists; do not relink this task.
mediaOps.block.budget_decision_present: A budget decision already exists; review it before recovery.
mediaOps.block.dispatch_credential_unver: The original dispatch credential cannot be verified. No replacement account will be used.
mediaOps.block.control_in_progress: A task control operation is in progress. Wait and reload the basis.
mediaDisposition.title: Media evidence review
mediaDisposition.help: An administrator decision, not supplier invoice confirmation. Original evidence and prices stay intact. Accepting an alternative may change costs; review how future events will be handled.
mediaDisposition.help.continue_ordered: Later signed sequences may supersede this evidence. Equal sequences still need review; older sequences cannot replace it.
mediaDisposition.help.manual_review: Future updates are retained for review, not automatically applied. Resume only by reviewing and accepting a signed snapshot with an explicit sequence.
mediaDisposition.help.unchanged: Rejection preserves costs and the current ordering policy. The original evidence remains in history.
mediaDisposition.confirm: I reviewed this evidence, its cost and budget impact, and the policy for future events. Record this audited decision without changing original receipts.
mediaDisposition.budgetHelp: Budget changes belong to the original reservation and periods. Overlapping scopes are not separate supplier charges. This is a preview, not a guaranteed refund against the current period.
mediaDisposition.operation.initial: Accepting will queue the first terminal settlement under the original prices.
mediaDisposition.operation.adjustment: Accepting will queue a linked cost adjustment; the original receipt is preserved.
mediaDisposition.operation.noop: The computed cost is unchanged. Only evidence and ordering authority change.
mediaDisposition.operation.pending_only: The task stays pending. This decision does not settle a terminal charge.
mediaDisposition.operation.none: Rejection does not change costs, budgets or the task observation.
mediaDisposition.block.not_review_requir: This event does not require an operator decision.
mediaDisposition.block.already_disposed: This event already has an immutable decision.
mediaDisposition.block.pending_processin: Finish the retained financial processing before accepting another alternative. Rejection is still available.
mediaDisposition.block.terminal_regressi: A terminal task cannot return to pending. You can reject this alternative.
mediaDisposition.block.stale_sequence: This signed sequence is behind the current ordering floor. Only rejection is available.
mediaDisposition.block.budget_decision_p: The original budget decision must be reconciled before accepting this evidence.
mediaDisposition.block.control_in_progre: A task control request is in progress. Reread its state after it finishes.
mediaDisposition.uncertain: The write outcome is unknown; this decision may already be recorded. Check its receipt or retry the same operation ID. Do not submit a new decision.
mediaDisposition.sessionHelp: This browser session stores only the scoped operation ID, reviewed hashes, decision, ordering policy and reason for an exact retry. It does not store provider payloads or credentials.
mediaDisposition.inspectOnly: Read-only access. Only workspace administrators can accept or reject media evidence.
nativeVideo.help: Explicitly select the returned schema; existing tasks keep their original interpreter. Native profiles require native request bodies and configured status endpoints. Returned output counts are supported; actual seconds, acceptance/completion times, cancellation and downloads are not inferred.
report.title: Cost coverage report
report.description: Separate calculated charges, estimates and unknown costs across retained requests.
report.timeHelp: Enter UTC. Snapshot requests use admission time; legacy-only logs use their recorded time. Maximum range: 366 days.
report.invalidWindow: Choose a valid positive UTC range of at most 366 days.
report.error: The page could not be verified. Earlier totals are retained, but the scan is incomplete. Retry the same next page.
report.scopeHelp: Includes retained request snapshots, including requests without logs, plus legacy-only logs. Deleted or never-persisted traffic is not measurable here. This report covers the whole workspace, not the filters on the log page.
report.consistency: Each page is a consistent read; corrections and retention may change data between pages. This is not a single point-in-time snapshot or a supplier invoice.
report.amountHelp: Do not add these figures and call the result a complete actual cost. Coverage means priced/free requests divided by scanned requests; estimates and legacy rows do not count as calculated coverage.
report.compatibilityHelp: These existing totals are floating-point compatibility projections, not a complete actual-cost report. Use the coverage report for separate statuses and exact decimal sums.
report.missingEvidence: A request snapshot exists, but its cost evidence is unavailable. The stored log number is not treated as confirmed or free.
metering.title: Metering review
metering.help: This checks implemented extraction paths, not supplier support or receipt completeness. A saved rate alone cannot make missing usage billable.
metering.conditional: Conditional coverage — review the evidence requirements
metering.blocked: Publication blocked: no matching metering path
metering.availability.conditional: Requires provider fields or supported measurement
metering.availability.local_measurement: Local counter; failure evidence may be missing
metering.invalid: The metering review is incomplete or changed. Preview again.
metering.notice.operation_unspecified: The binding does not specify an operation. Compatibility across every possible route is not verified.
metering.notice.modality_allocation_requ: Modality prices require explicit supplier token details. Cached input needs attributable cache details; candidate output may omit thinking tokens. Missing quantities are not zero. Verify limits and use upper-bound admission for budget protection.
metering.notice.provider_evidence_requir: Required provider fields may be absent, malformed or estimated; actual requests can remain unknown.
metering.notice.request_basis_only: Requested quantities are not actual output or supplier limits. Use only an explicitly request-billed contract.
metering.notice.manual_evidence_required: This selected native profile does not report actual duration. An authenticated supplier source or reviewed attestation is needed; requested duration is not a substitute.
metering.notice.supplier_contract_requir: Service-tier labels do not prove model support. Confirm the exact model, resolved tier and supplier contract before publishing.
metering.notice.timestamp_contract_requi: Provider acceptance/completion timestamps are not guaranteed. Native video profiles do not synthesize these instants.
metering.notice.operation_unsupported: This operation is not integrated with pricing settlement.
metering.notice.dimension_unsupported: The selected billing basis has no matching integrated metering operation.
metering.notice.limits_not_verified: Administrator-declared limits remain conditional supplier assertions, not verified hard caps.
metering.notice.model_support_unverified: Model/provider support is not verified by this code inventory. No paid provider probe is performed.
metering.notice.video_profile_unspecifie: Video result profile is not pinned by this binding. Review each eligible node; native profiles may need separate duration evidence.
admissionPreview.title: Admission simulation
admissionPreview.help: Inspect the current published catalog and price-policy decision without reserving budget.
admissionPreview.safety: This is not the draft-price simulator. Published prices, calendars and FX apply at the evaluation time. No model is called, no hold is created and no policy is saved.
admissionPreview.evidenceHelp: These are manually entered hypothetical quantities and evidence labels, not verified provider usage. Blank is unknown; heuristic evidence cannot be marked observed.
admissionPreview.conditions: Times, service tier and media conditions
admissionPreview.timeHelp: Use Z or an explicit UTC offset. Leave unavailable provider timestamps blank; do not substitute request duration or local time. Catalog activation is evaluated now, not at these hypothetical event times.
admissionPreview.override: Use an unpublished policy for this simulation
admissionPreview.overrideHelp: Off: use the effective workspace/global policy. On: the proposal affects this simulation only. Declared limits are not verified supplier caps.
admissionPreview.invalidInputs: Enter a model, 1–1000 attempts and valid nonnegative decimal quantities. Any declared limit needs a reference.
admissionPreview.invalidReply: The response does not match this scenario or is incomplete. Evaluate again.
admissionPreview.decisionHelp: This does not check remaining budget, live routing, credential availability or provider support. It is not authorization to dispatch a real request.
admissionPreview.envelopeHelp: These exact original-currency fractions form a conservative envelope over eligible rules, not a supplier invoice or the cheapest current rate. FX and outward rounding produce the reported bound.
admissionPreview.quoteHelp: This quote uses the scenario quantities and selected published tariff. It can differ from the conservative reservation. An estimate or unknown amount is not a confirmed charge. Missing quantities may use declared limits as marked estimates.
limits.title: Capacity limits
limits.help: Host-wide settings in pricing_limits. Each price version is counted once. Lowering a limit does not change active prices, in-flight requests or history; oversized new publications and actions are rejected.
error.capacity: This publication exceeds the configured rule capacity. Reduce the planned rules or ask the host operator to adjust pricing_limits.
error.requestTooLarge: This pricing request exceeds the configured size limit. Reduce the request or ask the host operator to adjust pricing_limits.
recovery.actual.help: The server accounts for every paid attempt, including failed retries. No winner or manual debit can be selected.
recovery.actual.needsFence: Confirmation fences the recorded population against new dispatches.
recovery.actual.pendingTitle: Recovery recorded — no settlement by this action
recovery.actual.pendingHelp: This operation recorded a dispatch fence, not a final settlement. It retained the hold at that time. Reread evidence for the current budget state.
recovery.actual.pending.evidence_incompl: Cost or required upstream-token evidence is incomplete; retain the hold.
recovery.actual.pending.runtime_custody: Retained runtime evidence still needs delivery or explicit review.
recovery.actual.pending.runtime_group_cu: Retained complete-group evidence still needs delivery or explicit review.
recovery.actual.pending.missing_dispatch: Missing dispatch evidence is unresolved. Rejecting a receipt does not prove zero supplier expense.
recovery.actual.cache: A local cache hit uses zero supplier budget; logical response usage is preserved.
recovery.actual.noDebit: No debit applied — not a free supplier request
recovery.actual.recordedImpactHelp: These are this operation's recorded effects, not the current provider or budget state. Later evidence may already have settled the hold.
recovery.actual.unknownAtAction: Unconfirmed attempts in this operation: {{count}}. Reread evidence for their current status.
budgetBasis.title: Budget accounting basis
budgetBasis.help.default: Omitting this field preserves legacy accounting. It does not inherit a budget basis from a lower-priority policy; remove the whole policy to restore inheritance.
budgetBasis.help.legacy_logical: Keep existing logical-request accounting, including logical cache usage. Supplier expense remains a separate report.
budgetBasis.help.actual_upstream: Count all confirmed paid attempts, including failed retries. Local cache consumes no supplier budget. Unknown costs keep their holds pending.
budgetBasis.availability: Actual expense is currently connected only for: {{operations}}. Other lifecycles remain under implementation.
budgetBasis.unsupported: Choose a supported operation before enabling actual expense accounting.
budgetBasis.globalImpact: Global behavior shown before workspace overrides. Existing workspace policies can take precedence.
budgetBasis.workspaceImpact: Effective behavior in this workspace, including operation-specific and global fallback policies.
budgetBasis.futureOnly: This is a policy impact preview, not a predicted bill. Publishing affects new admissions only; existing holds, requests and historical costs keep their original policy.
budgetBasis.simulationOnly: Simulation only. This quote is not final supplier expense and does not publish a policy or change a budget.
tokenBudget.title: Token budget
tokenBudget.help.default: Preserve existing rule selection and accounting. This is not field-level inheritance.
tokenBudget.help.reported_tokens: When token rules exist, require reported token totals. Missing counters keep holds pending, even when zero tokens were reserved.
tokenBudget.help.not_applicable: Only for supported image, video, audio, rerank or Realtime operations with a published price book containing no token dimensions. Missing or mixed token prices block dispatch. Monetary budgets and already admitted requests are unchanged.
tokenBudget.unsupported: Select actual-upstream accounting and a supported operation, or clear this option.
diagnostic.pricing_token_budget_incompat: Token budget selection is incompatible with the frozen price dimensions
admissionPreview.reason.token_budget_inc: Token budget selection is incompatible with the frozen price dimensions
recovery.actual.pending.media_custody: A media task or retained media evidence still needs completion, processing or explicit review.
transcription.title: Independent input transcription
transcription.help: Optional: enter both fields to reserve a separate ASR contract before connecting. Publish that model’s audio_transcription price and an actual-upstream upper-bound policy with per-item limits first. Unknown or different acknowledged models cannot send audio. Clear both fields to remove the declaration; direct audio conversation items and mid-buffer model changes are not supported.
rule.name: Rule name (optional)
rule.nameHelp: Display label only; the stable rule ID and matching conditions stay unchanged. Names are saved with each version and historical receipt. Clear this field to show only the ID.
modelStatus.title: Model pricing
modelStatus.help: Read-only, operation-specific price bindings, not a quote. A published price does not verify supplier support or complete metering. Conditional prices depend on usage, time and service level; legacy prices are reference only.
modelStatus.schema: The pricing schema is not installed. No new-engine price binding is active; legacy references are shown separately.
modelStatus.missing: No active new-engine binding for this operation. This does not mean free; compatibility mode may use a legacy estimate.
modelStatus.expires: This binding expires without a new-engine fallback. Recheck the admission policy before expiry.
modelStatus.truncated: Only the first eight effective changes are shown. Open the price book to review all bindings.
modelStatus.contextHelp: This context does not change any binding. New drafts retain the target; publication still requires an explicit impact preview and confirmation.
modelStatus.newForTarget: New price book for this target
management.title: Book management
management.stateHelp: Status describes time-eligible bindings, not guaranteed selection: a more specific override may win. Drafts remain separate. Refresh to check a later time.
management.ownerHelp: Use a user or team label for operational responsibility. This does not grant permissions, send alerts, publish prices, or change historical costs. New books initially name their creator; older unassigned books remain unassigned.
management.clearHelp: Leave blank to explicitly clear the owner. Do not enter secrets.
management.confirm: I confirm this responsibility change only; prices and access remain unchanged.
management.saved: Owner saved. Prices and access are unchanged.
management.conflict: Another administrator changed the owner. Your input is retained. Close and reopen this editor to review the latest owner before saving again.
error.replayLimit: Historical simulation exceeds its resource limits. Select fewer records or ask an administrator to review the limits.
error.replayTimeout: Historical simulation reached its time limit. Try fewer records or retry later.
error.replayBusy: Historical simulation is busy. Try again shortly.
historicalFx.title: Historical exchange rate
historicalFx.help: The rate fixed at request admission, verified against this retained receipt. Current rates are not substituted.
historicalFx.notNeeded: No conversion is required: original and reporting currencies match.
historicalFx.missing: No retained FX reference. The reporting amount stays unknown; current rates are not substituted.
historicalFx.unavailable: Historical FX evidence is unavailable or inconsistent. The recorded cost is unchanged.
contextTable.title: Context range table
contextTable.help: Ranges are [minimum, maximum); a blank maximum has no upper bound. Conflicts use the server's condition-overlap rule, including tier/time/media and priority. This is not full document validation; select a rule to edit its rates below.
contextTable.problems: {{count}} rules need range or overlap review.
contextTable.invalid: Enter nonnegative integer bounds with maximum greater than minimum, and a valid priority.
contextTable.noOverlap: No equal-priority overlap in this group
calendarWeek.title: Normalized calendar week
calendarWeek.help: Preview the Monday–Sunday week containing this local date. Unsaved calendar edits are previewed only; no price, budget or history is changed.
calendarWeek.date: Date in the calendar time zone
calendarWeek.failed: Week preview failed. No partial schedule is accepted.
calendarWeek.stale: Calendar or date changed. Preview again to see the new schedule.
calendarWeek.civil: Civil clock schedule only: daylight-saving gaps and repeated hours are not elapsed billable duration. Actual requests use absolute timestamps.
calendarWeek.uncovered: Outside calendar coverage; no time tag is assumed.
mediaOps.statusHelp: Generation and accounting are independent. Failed or cancelled jobs can incur charges. Processed accounting does not confirm successful content delivery.
mediaOps.deliveryUntracked: Delivery result is not recorded here
cacheReference.title: Cache comparison basis
cacheReference.basis: Only stored token-log estimates are compared; these are not verified supplier savings.
cacheReference.coverage: {{comparable}} of {{eligible}} token requests have a comparison; {{excluded}} non-token requests are excluded.
cacheReference.unavailable: No comparable baseline is available. Missing or advanced-pricing references are not recreated with current rates.
cacheReference.partial: Known comparable savings subtotal: {{value}}. This is not the total for the period.
cacheReference.truncated: Only the first {{count}} matching logs are shown (limit {{limit}}); more rows exist.
cacheReference.breakdownUnavailable: Per-dimension reference costs were not retained. Current prices cannot reconstruct that historical breakdown.
mediaSpec.title: Media specification authority
mediaSpec.help: Fixed values belong to this price version and override request parameters. Conflicting provider results remain unpriced; model names never imply a specification.
mediaSpec.conflict: Provider result conflicts with the model contract
mediaSpec.legacy: Legacy selection; no explicit source contract
metering.notice.media_specification_oper: An explicit media operation is required to publish this specification contract.
metering.notice.model_fixed_specificatio: Fixed specifications are administrator contract declarations, not observed provider output. Verify the model binding and supplier contract before publishing.
calculationPolicy.title: Recorded calculation policy
calculationPolicy.help: From the exact original price version. This explains recorded quantities; it does not recalculate or change fees.
calculationPolicy.unavailable: The policy cannot be matched to this receipt. Current prices are not substituted.
calculationPolicy.noLines: No billed component lines were recorded.
calculationPolicy.zero: Minimums apply only to positive usage. Observed zero remains zero.
calculationPolicy.physical: These policies and quantities belong to the physical batch, not this allocated share. Do not add them as another charge.
